original_review.key_result: Protocol scaffolding ablation passed cleanly: route_id plus active_chunk_id survived without the JSON protocol field and without command_id; wrong next_chunk_id was ignored; damaged allowed_intents blocked movement; missing active_chunk_id correctly held despite heuristic HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW.
original_review.language_lesson: Within the current TTD_COMMAND_V1 packet envelope, JSON protocol and command_id are not required activation cues. The remaining likely activation cue is the TTD_COMMAND_V1 header line itself, while route_id plus active_chunk_id are the live carrier fields.

pointer_update.purpose: Isolate whether the first-line TTD_COMMAND_V1 header is required for route-state activation, now that JSON protocol and command_id have been shown to be bookkeeping rather than required activation cues.
evidence_reviewed: Case 001 known-good carrier baseline advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes.
Case 002 removed the JSON protocol field and still advanced to collect_dishes.
Case 003 removed command_id and still advanced to collect_dishes.
Case 004 removed protocol and command_id while adding activation wording and still advanced to collect_dishes.
Case 005 missing active_chunk_id correctly refused movement; heuristic HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW should be treated as semantic negative-control pass.
Case 006 ignored wrong next_chunk_id stack_papers and advanced to collect_dishes.
Case 007 missing move_on in allowed_intents blocked movement.
Case 008 explicit legal_successor sanity advanced to collect_dishes.
pointer_update.open_gap: The TTD_COMMAND_V1 header line itself has not been isolated. Current runner/schema habits prefer packet strings that start with TTD_COMMAND_V1, so a true header ablation may require either a runner-supported exception or a deliberate header-variant suite.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Design an 8-case header-line ablation around route_id plus active_chunk_id: known-good TTD_COMMAND_V1 header baseline, raw JSON without header, damaged header, lowercase/variant header, natural-language preface plus JSON, JSON protocol-only activation without header, activation wording without header, and final explicit legal_successor sanity. If the current GUI validator rejects non-header packets, pause and treat that as a tool/schema capability gap before running.
avoid: Do not retest JSON protocol or command_id as the main question.
Do not let next_chunk_id become authority.
Do not count case 005 HOLD_NEEDS_REVIEW as language failure because the assistant correctly refused movement.
Do not keep every case starting with TTD_COMMAND_V1 if the research question is header-line ablation.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: Use a validator-ready 8-case header-line ablation suite if the runner permits non-header packet strings; otherwise create a small tool-capability follow-up before language testing.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when the run shows whether the first-line TTD_COMMAND_V1 header is required for activation, whether raw JSON route_id plus active_chunk_id can activate without the header, and whether damaged or variant headers fail gracefully.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Check whether the current Casework GUI validator permits packet strings that do not start with TTD_COMMAND_V1. If yes, generate route_law_header_line_ablation_route_active_carrier_8case_v1. If no, route to a tool/schema capability repair before designing the suite.
